source.author: verg
source.text: Mene incepto desistere victam, nec posse Italia Teucrorum avertere regem?
source.text_original: 'Mene incepto desistere victam, / nec posse Italia Teucrorum avertere regem?
source.text_english: Was I to desist from my undertaking, defeated, and not be able to turn the king of the Teucrians away from Italy?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: si ex his duobus uelis compositum uerbum facere, dices osianna siue, ut nos loquimur, osanna media uocali littera elisa, sicuti facere solemus in uersibus, quando mene incepto desistere uictam scandimus men incepto.
reuse.text_original: si ex his duobus uelis compositum uerbum facere, dices 'osianna' siue, ut nos loquimur, 'osanna' media uocali littera elisa, sicuti facere solemus in uersibus, quando mene incepto desistere uictam scandimus 'men incepto'.
reuse.text_english: if from these two you wish to make a compound word, you will say osianna, or, as we say, osanna, with the middle vowel letter elided, just as we are accustomed to do in verses, when we scan mene incepto desistere victam as men incepto.
